seed: Create a NEW high quality landscape pixel-art videogame area map, ideally 3840x2160, for a top-down 2D open-world RPG. This is actual flat game background art, not an illustration of a miniature, not isometric, no UI/text/people. Full-frame world with no border, title, legend, floating island or sky. Visual treatment: crisp hand-placed looking pixel clusters, restrained earthy palette, clearly readable 16-bit fantasy RPG tiles and props, consistent sprite scale and south-facing facades, sun from upper left. No painterly texture or 3D render. A frontier trading waystation organically built around the fork of an old caravan road amid wilderness. Design the area deliberately rather than evenly scattering assets: a broad warm dirt road enters the left-bottom edge, winds through a compact off-center market square with a well, then continues out the middle of the right edge so it can be extended. Roughly ten varied buildings grouped into functional courtyards: inn and stable north of the square, smithy and stockyard east, three modest homes with garden plots south-west. Buildings should remain small relative to traversable open space; visible doors, coherent roof silhouettes, consistent scale and clear pedestrian routes. A broken stone watchtower on a wooded rocky ridge above the north side serves as a memorable landmark. A narrow stream runs along the south-east with a small wooden bridge and ford. Two readable secondary trail loops depart the central road, one visits the ruined tower and campsite, another follows the stream then returns to the market. Avoid dead-end paths at impassable walls or water; put gaps in fences at paths and leave doors accessible. Use trees, rock outcrops and modest terrain ledges to frame distinct spaces, but leave breathing room and sightlines at junctions. Environmental storytelling in purposeful small clusters: cart tracks reach the warehouse loading yard, charcoal and lumber at the smithy, fallen masonry at the tower, little fenced gardens at homes. Muted olive greens, warm sand soil, clay red roofs, cold gray ruins, dark teal stream. Road hierarchy and a few strong compositional focal points should be obvious at gameplay scale. Right edge should have open meadow and a road exit, suitable for seamlessly extending the world to the east. Roofs are opaque for this outdoor base; actual indoor floors and dynamic roof hiding must be separate future layers, not fake windows into another scene.
